query: A privileged account logged in successfully after repeated failed logins. What does our SOP require, and what does our escalation matrix say?

answer_constraints: Do not call the account compromised without post-login evidence or approval.
retrieved_entries.citation: COE Sample Auth Investigation SOP v1.0 AUTH-003
retrieved_entries.entry_title: Successful Login After Repeated Failures Guidance
recommended_actions: Correlate failure and success events for same user and src.
Check if source is new for the user.
retrieved_entries.source_excerpt: A successful login following repeated failures should be reviewed for account criticality, source novelty, and session activity before escalation.

answer_constraints: Do not declare compromise from failed-login counts alone.
Require approved evidence before severity or root-cause conclusions.
retrieved_entries.citation: COE Sample Auth Investigation SOP v1.0 AUTH-001
retrieved_entries.entry_title: Brute Force / Failed Login Spike SOP
recommended_actions: Review failed-login volume and source distribution.
Check for successful login after repeated failures.
Escalate when privileged accounts or broad source spread are involved.
retrieved_entries.source_excerpt: For a failed-login spike, verify account, source IP distribution, time window, and any successful login after repeated failures before escalation.

answer_constraints: Escalation guidance is advisory and does not authorize execution.
retrieved_entries.citation: COE Sample Auth Escalation Matrix v1.0 ESC-AUTH-001
recommended_actions: Review the validated SPL and collection status before approving mock execution.
Request more evidence if source coverage is insufficient.
retrieved_entries.source_excerpt: Escalate auth scenarios to a tier2 SOC analyst when privileged accounts, success-after-failure, or broad source distribution are present.

retrieved_entries.doc_title: Skill enrichment guidance: auth failed login spike
retrieved_entries.entry_title: Answer rules: auth failed login spike
retrieved_entries.source_excerpt: Do not claim account compromise from failed logins alone. Mark brute force as evidence-supported only after threshold evidence exists. SPL/execution remains review-gated.

retrieved_entries.doc_title: Skill enrichment guidance: auth failed login spike
retrieved_entries.entry_title: Limitations and non-claims: auth failed login spike
retrieved_entries.source_excerpt: Failed login telemetry alone does not establish credential validity. Source IP reuse, NAT, or scanner behavior may require analyst review.
